subject: OliveTech reference request — sensitivity check before publish
messages:
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@olivetech.com>, Nathan White <nathan.white@olivetech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Draft case study + quick permission ask

Hi Priya / Nathan —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. We pulled together a very short draft case study based on the pilot you ran and the outcomes Marcus and I discussed. Attached is the two-page draft (olive-case-draft-v1.pdf) — it focuses on the latency and cost improvements OliveTech saw after moving inference to Redwood Dedicated.

Can I get permission to publish this as a customer reference and to share a 1–2 minute quote from Priya on our website and sales one-pager? We can strip any technical details you prefer and share the final copy for sign-off before it goes live.

If there's any reason you'd like us to delay publication, please let us know — we want to be respectful of your timing.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: olive-case-draft-v1.pdf (PDF, 95KB)
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@olivetech.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nathan White <nathan.white@olivetech.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft case study + quick permission ask

Hi Laura —

Thanks for sending this over and for the thoughtful write-up. We appreciate the work you and Marcus put into the pilot.

We are open to being a reference in principle, but I need to flag one thing: we had an incident two weeks ago where a partial outage affected inference latency for a handful of production jobs. Our engineering team is still finishing the postmortem and there's some debate internally about how public-facing we want to be on vendor success communications until that's fully closed.

Could we please pause any publication while we finish our review? We will aim to confirm a safe go/no-go by EOD Friday (2026-03-06). For now please do not publish the draft or use any quotes that attribute specific performance numbers to OliveTech.

Appreciate the flexibility — Priya
Priya Desai
Head of Data Engineering | OliveTech
priya.desai@olivetech.com

Quick thoughts: 1) We should honor the pause. 2) Need to check if we already scheduled shareable assets in the CMS and social queue and remove if so. 3) Legal/PR risk — do we need any sign-off or language to limit claims?

Laura / Marcus —

Per my last CS check-ins: OliveTech slowed usage in two of their pilot teams the week of 2026-02-16 after that latency blip, but they're still actively running experimental jobs in other teams. They have not opened churn discussions yet, but NPS slipped a couple points in Feb.

My recommendation: honor the pause and treat this as high-sensitivity: do not publish anything until Priya confirms. We should also proactively offer them an embargoed review: keep the draft in Google Drive but do not push live. If marketing has scheduled posts, pull them and replace with a generic 'customer spotlight coming soon' placeholder.

I'll reach out to the CS lead at OliveTech for a quick sentiment check and to offer support on the postmortem if helpful.

—Monica

Priya —

Thanks for the heads up and for your transparency. Per OliveTech's request, we will pause publication and remove all scheduled posts and the site banner. We have marked the draft as EMBARGOED in our Drive and removed any queued social copy. We also redacted specific config/throughput lines from the public draft per our security team's guidance.

Please take the time you need to finish your internal review. If it helps, Monica and I can set up a 30-minute working session with your engineering lead to walk through the postmortem and confirm any wording that would make your communications team comfortable.

If we don't hear back by EOD Friday (2026-03-06) we'll follow up again, otherwise we'll await your explicit written approval to publish.
